name: Current Trends in IT Security
description:
IT Security is an important field of computer science in the Internet-driven era. It refers to the process of implementing systems and measures that can protect  and secure information. However, IT Security evolves over the years as new attacks introduced that require new defense strategies. Therefore, the topics of the lecture cover among the others:

-- Network security
-- Web security
-- Malware
-- Privacy
-- Underground economy
-- Internet of Things (IoT) security
prerequisites: IN0009 Basic Principles: Operating Systems and System Software
